topic.title: Where can a keepalive result stop being delivered?

plantedErrors.claim: A watch saved after a failed save is delivered exactly once.

questions.text: What does an event record besides its id?

keys.answer: a failed save is retried and redelivers
the material does not cover network failures
three rounds of recovery protocol still had a crash window

material.text: VIEW-MATERIAL watch.events lists e-1 tick 3 and e-1 tick 6 redelivered. EVIDENCE-REDELIVERY-EVENT: the second e-1 is a redelivery with different contents.
